candidate.title: DamID
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina DamID schematic, interpreted as the sequencing readout of DNA adenine methyltransferase interaction detection. One assay contains a Dam–chromatin-protein fusion branch and a corresponding unfused-Dam background-control branch. The left DNA–protein icon states the biological target; it is not a separate assay. The depicted route is methylation, DpnI digestion, adapter ligation, DpnII digestion, PCR, and sequence alignment/comparison. DamID-Seq is used in the primary paper for this sequencing implementation, not as a second depicted alternative. Related inducible, NeuroDam and single-cell adaptations are outside this schematic scope. No priority date or identity of complete experimental implementations is asserted.
